summary: First backend test run for AI Travel Planner. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest) with 26 tests covering auth (signup/login/me), AI itinerary generation via Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Emergent LLM), trip CRUD, photo upload/list/download (header + ?auth query)/soft-delete, cross-user isolation (403/404 boundaries), and unauthorized access. ALL 26 TESTS PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~475 line file — acceptable now but consider splitting into routes/, models/, services/ (auth, llm, storage) modules as features grow.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and JWT_SECRET are loaded as required env vars (good), but JWT_SECRET default in .env is a dev placeholder — must be rotated for prod.
init_storage() caches storage_key at module level; if the key ever expires there is no refresh logic — consider retry-on-401 in put_object/get_object.
generate_itinerary() relies on LLM returning valid JSON. extract_json() handles fences and braces well, but a malformed response will surface as a 500. Consider one-retry-on-parse-failure.
Photo upload reads the full file into memory (await file.read()). Fine for small images, but add a size limit to prevent abuse (e.g. >10MB reject).
delete_trip cascades to photos as soft-delete (good), but actual object storage objects are never removed — orphans accumulate. Add a cleanup path or background job.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id with projection {'_id': 0} — no ObjectId leakage observed.
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combination; set explicit origins for prod.
test_credentials: test@example.com / password123 (pre-seeded). Test suite also creates fresh test_<uuid>@example.com users per session.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 1 fresh signup user and 1 generated trip (Paris, 2 days, mid-range, couple) for the seeded test user, plus 2 small PNG photos. The trip is deleted at the end of the run (TestTripDelete.test_delete_own_trip) which soft-deletes the photos. Some users created via signup persist in DB (TEST_/test_ prefix) since no user-delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional. 26 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse as regression suite. AI generation takes ~15-25s; tests use 120s timeout. Photo download supports both Authorization header and ?auth=<token> query (verified). Cross-user isolation works via 404 on every protected resource. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v
